series: trendwatching.com annual consumer trends (free Trend Briefing)
title: 10 TRENDS for 2015
notes: First archived 2014-11-28. Subtitle '10 trends shaping consumerism in 2015'. Quotes are each section's opening line (dek) or first claim sentence. A print PDF existed (x/wp-content/uploads/2014/11/2014-12-10-TRENDS-FOR-2015.pdf), not read. target_year 2015 from the title.

entries.label: INSTANT SKILLS
entries.quote: Why 2015's status-hungry prosumers will LOVE services that allow professional-quality output – minus the learning or time barriers.
entries.subject: Tools giving consumers instant professional-quality output

entries.label: FAST-LANING
entries.quote: In 2015, expect perennially time-starved customers to demand accelerated physical service options, especially from brands they extend their loyalty towards.
entries.subject: Paid or loyalty-based fast lanes for physical service

entries.label: FAIR SPLITTING
entries.quote: 2015 will (finally!) be the year when mobile payment platforms become commonplace.
entries.subject: Mobile payments for splitting costs
entries.note: Section cites Juniper Research: 450 million mobile payment users forecast by 2017 (from 245 million at end-2013). Third-party forecast, not trendwatching's own; not recorded as metric.

entries.label: INTERNET OF SHARING THINGS
entries.quote: In 2015, the Internet of Things and the Sharing Economy collide to allow a whole new world of asset sharing: spontaneous, useful, fun, profitable and more.
entries.subject: Connected objects enabling shared access
entries.note: Label printed two ways: 'INTERNET OF SHARING THINGS' (section heading and intro, used here) and 'INTERNET OF SHARED THINGS' (overview list). Follows THE INTERNET OF CARING THINGS (2014).

entries.label: BRANDED GOVERNMENT
entries.quote: 2015 will be the year for progressive brands to initiate, undertake or support meaningful civic transformation.
entries.subject: Brands delivering civic and public services

entries.label: POST-DEMOGRAPHIC CONSUMERISM
entries.quote: people – of all ages and in many markets – are constructing their own identities more freely than ever.
entries.subject: Consumption no longer defined by demographics
entries.note: Refers to the November 2014 Trend Briefing of the same name.

entries.label: CURRENCIES OF CHANGE
entries.quote: In search of wellness, strength, new skills, knowledge and more, 2015's consumers will embrace device-fueled rewards that incentivize improving behaviours.
entries.subject: Rewards for self-improving behaviour

entries.label: SYMPATHETIC PRICING
entries.quote: Get ready for a wave of imaginative discounts that relieve lifestyle pain points or offer a helping hand in difficult times.
entries.subject: Compassionate, cause-linked discounts
entries.note: Refers to the June 2014 Trend Briefing of the same name.

entries.label: ROBOLOVE
entries.quote: many consumers will have their first face-to-face encounters with robots in 2015. And they'll enjoy them.
entries.subject: Customer-facing service robots
entries.note: Section cites Amazon (10,000 Kiva robots by end-2014) and BCG (20-40% fulfillment cost cut); third-party figures, not recorded as metric.

entries.label: BRAND STANDS
entries.quote: In 2015, winning brands will start contentious, painful and necessary conversations.
entries.subject: Brands taking public stances
